onboarding.step1Desc: Welcome to Whispering Wishes — your Wuthering Waves companion. Let's walk through the main features in a few steps.
onboarding.step2Desc: Import your Convene history in the Profile tab to enable automatic pity tracking. You can also personalize the app's appearance, ambient music, and back up your data via export/import.
onboarding.step3Desc: See all active banners, your pity progress (pulls since your last 5★), and countdowns before they end. You can also check your full pull history and each banner's own publication history, with filters and a search bar.
onboarding.step4Desc: Keep an overview of all your Resonators, weapons, and echoes obtained and currently in-game.
onboarding.step5Desc: Build resonator teams and preview rotation damage before using them in combat.
onboarding.step6Desc: Enter your available resources and current pull progress to see your exact probabilities of getting the character or weapon you're after.
onboarding.step7Desc: Check the full history and details of your Convenes with precise charts, and compare your luck rating against other players on the leaderboard.
onboarding.step8Desc: You've covered the essentials. You can replay this tour anytime from Profile > About > Replay onboarding. Good luck on your Convenes!
onboarding.step9Desc: See ongoing and upcoming events, rewards, and deadlines in the Events tab.
onboarding.step10Desc: Find collectibles, resources, and points of interest in the Map tab.
onboarding.step11Desc: Track upcoming income and time your pulls in the Planner tab.
